blocks.text: Macrophages monocytes (white blood cells ki aik qism) se bante hain. Macrophage bacterium ko endocytosis (cell membrane se gher kar andar le lena) ke zariye nigal leta hai aur apne lysozyme enzymes se use maar deta hai. Kuch macrophages kuch aaza (organs), maslan lungs, liver (jigar), spleen (tilli) aur brain (dimagh), mein aik jagah tike rehte hain, lekin zyada tar khoon, lymph aur interstitial fluid (cells ke darmiyan ka maya) mein gasht karte hain.

blocks.alt: Gehre firozi (teal) background par bara gulabi macrophage jis ki satah jhurridar hai aur aik lamba ubhaar oopar daen taraf jata hai; aas paas peele dande jaise (rod-shaped) bacteria; aik bacterium us ke oopar ke kinare se andar liya ja raha hai.
